description: Paid: 0.001 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Small loop-friendly combined reading: the worst current level across tracked public status pages, measured facilitator reachability and recent changes in our record. Returns storm (boolean), level (calm/breezy/unsettled/storm/unknown), one reason, asOf and sources, combining public AI-provider status pages (currently GitHub; full list at /v1/sources), our own measurement of x402 facilitator reachability and recent snapshot changes. Each source lists attribution, terms_url and not_affiliated; not affiliated with any source. Cached up to 60 s. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
